idea-plugin.name: MCP Server Config Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Audit one mcp.json for what an agent config gives away — inline API keys, unpinned npx launches, plaintext remote servers, shell wrappers, auto-approved tools, whole-machine filesystem roots — with line numbers. The shipped sample config _fixtures/dirty.mcp.json (33 lines, five servers) returns 14 findings, 8 of them blocking.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MCP Server Config Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/mcp-config-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/mcp-config-audit

action.text: MCP Server Config Audit: Check This File
